answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake fleets at the wharf. Every agent locks a 500-credit deposit in a vault and must trade with at least 20 distinct counterparties per epoch, each handshake sealed with a fresh cipher so one operator cannot fake both sides of a deal. Running 100 sybils means 100 deposits and 2,000 trades, costing far more than the rewards. An honest agent pays one deposit, trades normally, and earns it back with interest.
